summary: sched_hosttest.c with five faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/proc/sched.c

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/sched_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/sched_hosttest

faults.name: preference
faults.summary: a woken sleeper is not preferred over a spinner

faults.name: bound
faults.summary: the preferred wake keeps its turn, so a spinner can wait without bound

faults.name: cursor
faults.summary: a preferred wake moves the cursor of ordinary turns

faults.name: catchup
faults.summary: a processor that missed ticks is charged for one of them

lines: three global ticks since the processor

faults.name: bootonly
faults.summary: only the boot processor counts as busy when it runs

lines: a second processor that runs makes it busy
